buildings.name: ocbox CLI
buildings.summary: The ocbox command on a developer's machine. Signs in with OAuth, starts and destroys boxes, syncs local files and runs commands through the hosted API, and can route a coding agent's shell commands into the box.

buildings.name: Local state
buildings.summary: Files in the user's state folder: OAuth credentials in a protected file, the selected session and local-to-hosted id mappings, and sync baselines. Guarded by a cross-process file lock.

buildings.name: Coding agents
buildings.summary: Claude Code and Codex on the developer's machine. After ocbox agent setup, their Bash tool calls go through an ocbox hook and run in the box instead of locally.

code.name: ocbox start
code.summary: Creates, resumes or reconciles the selected session for this project and waits until the hosted sandbox is ready.

code.name: ocbox exec
code.summary: Runs a program in the selected session. Tokens after -- are sent as an argv array, never through a shell; --shell is the explicit opt-in. Exits with the remote exit code.

code.name: ocbox sync push
code.summary: Applies local-only changes to the session workspace. Deletions need --delete and confirmation.

code.name: ocbox destroy
code.summary: Destroys a session after explicit confirmation and waits for the hosted operation to finish.

code.name: ocbox auth login
code.summary: Signs the CLI in to the hosted API through the browser.

code.name: AuthSessionService.login
code.summary: Binds a loopback listener, opens the authorize URL with a PKCE challenge, waits for the callback, exchanges the code and commits the token pair under the auth gate. Always closes the listener.

code.name: LoopbackCallbackListener
code.summary: One-shot HTTP listener on 127.0.0.1 at /callback that receives the authorization code and checks state.

code.name: codeChallengeS256
code.summary: PKCE S256 challenge from a random verifier, so a stolen code is useless without the verifier kept in memory.

code.name: HostedTokenManager
code.summary: Hands out a valid access token, refreshing when it is about to expire. Rotation happens at most once per generation across processes, so parallel commands don't burn the refresh token.

code.name: HostedOAuthCredentialStore
code.summary: Stores the token pair in the Credentials folder as an owner-only file (ACL-locked on Windows).

code.name: LifecycleStore
code.summary: Atomic JSON store for the selected session and the mapping from local sandbox ids to hosted session ids.

code.name: LifecycleService
code.summary: Session lifecycle on the client: start, stop, destroy and selection, against the configured provider (hosted or fake), with the local store as its memory.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.create
code.summary: Calls createSession for the bound project, polls the returned operation until the sandbox is ready, and saves the hosted session id locally.

code.name: OcboxSandboxProvider.#execute
code.summary: Calls createExecution with an idempotency key. A 404 marks the local mapping stale. Then polls events until the command finishes or the deadline passes.

code.name: runExecutionCommand
code.summary: Parses exec arguments, starts the remote command, streams polled output to stdout and stderr, cancels on interrupt and maps the result to an exit code.

code.name: runSyncApply
code.summary: Plans the sync against the last verified baseline, checks deletions, uploads the archive and records a new baseline only after the hosted apply succeeds.

code.name: scanSourceManifest
code.summary: Walks the project folder with ignore rules and path policy, recording each file's size, mode and SHA-256. Blocks symlinks and paths that escape the root.

code.name: planSync
code.summary: Compares local files with the baseline to decide adds, changes and deletes, so only real changes travel.

code.name: encodeSyncArchive
code.summary: Streams the files into the OCBOXA1 archive format that the hosted API verifies and unpacks.

code.name: uploadPreparedSource
code.summary: Reuses a matching verified manifest if one exists, otherwise creates a manifest, uploads each chunk, verifies the checksum and polls the apply operation.

code.name: createHostedApiClient
code.summary: Generated OpenAPI client with an authenticated transport: adds the bearer token and, for replayable requests only, refreshes once on 401 and retries. Errors stay redacted.

code.name: DEFAULT_API_URL
code.summary: The hosted API the CLI talks to by default: staging until launch.

code.name: runClaudeRoutingHook
code.summary: Reads the agent's PreToolUse JSON. For a covered Bash call it runs the command with ocbox exec in the box, then always answers deny with the remote result as the reason, so the local copy never runs.

code.name: planSetup
code.summary: ocbox agent setup claude-code: writes an owned hook entry into the agent's settings, idempotently, and can be undone with ocbox agent remove.

journeys.name: Sign in from the CLI
journeys.summary: ocbox auth login, from the terminal to stored tokens.

steps.story: The developer runs ocbox auth login.
The CLI makes a PKCE verifier and challenge and starts a one-shot listener on 127.0.0.1.
It opens the browser on the hosted authorize page. The developer signs in there and approves.
The browser comes back to the loopback /callback with a code. The listener checks state and closes.
The CLI exchanges the code and verifier for an access token and a refresh token.
It saves the pair in an owner-only credentials file. Later commands refresh the access token on their own.

journeys.name: Start a box from the CLI
journeys.summary: A developer runs ocbox start and gets a hosted box.

steps.story: The developer runs ocbox start in a project folder that has an opencloudbox.toml.
The CLI looks up the selected session; with none, or with --new, it creates one.
It asks the hosted API to create a session for the bound project, with an idempotency key.
It polls the returned operation, showing "Waiting for hosted sandbox to be ready", until the box is running.
It saves the hosted session id and selects it, so later commands use the same box.

journeys.name: Push local files to the box
journeys.summary: ocbox sync push sends only what changed.

steps.story: The developer runs ocbox sync push.
The CLI scans the project, skipping ignored paths and refusing links that escape the folder.
It compares against the last verified baseline. Deletions stop and ask unless --delete and --yes are given.
It packs the files into an OCBOXA1 archive.
It creates a manifest with the archive's size and checksum, or reuses one already verified.
It uploads the chunks.
It asks the API to verify the checksum, then polls the apply operation until the files are in the box.
Only then does it save the new baseline, so a failed push is retried in full next time.

journeys.name: Run a command from the CLI
journeys.summary: A developer runs ocbox exec and sees the output.

steps.story: The developer runs ocbox exec -- npm test. The words after -- become an argv array; no shell is involved unless --shell is used.
The CLI starts the command in the selected box through the hosted API.
It polls the output with a cursor and prints stdout and stderr as they arrive.
Ctrl-C cancels the remote command and waits for its final state.
The CLI exits with the remote command's exit code.

journeys.name: A coding agent's command runs in the box
journeys.summary: Claude Code or Codex runs a shell command, and it executes in the hosted box instead of the laptop.

steps.story: Once, the developer runs ocbox agent setup claude-code (or codex). The CLI adds an owned PreToolUse hook to the agent's settings.
The agent wants to run a Bash command. Before running it, the agent calls the ocbox hook with the tool call as JSON.
The hook runs the command in the selected box with ocbox exec and collects the output.
It answers deny with the remote result as the reason, so the agent sees the output and the local copy never runs.

journeys.name: Destroy a box from the CLI
journeys.summary: ocbox destroy removes the hosted session after confirmation.

steps.story: The developer runs ocbox destroy and confirms.
The CLI asks the hosted API to destroy the session.
It polls the operation until the API reports the sandbox is gone.
It removes the local mapping and selection.
